_note: Soldier builds on the book's special classes (Core p.322-323): Squad (npcc_squad) and Human (npcc_human). The numbers come from the official local pack (local/content/core_npcs.json, never committed; docs/NPC_PACK.md) when it's there, else our placeholders (data/game/npc_placeholder_pack.json). 'optional' = the book's optional modules; 'damage_type' = the pick the book leaves to when the squad is made; 'role' only steers the AI. A kind's name and job beyond its modules are flavour.

rifle_squad.name: Rifle Squad
rifle_squad.job: Ten soldiers with rifles and a heavy weapon. They close to rifle range and shoot.

missile_team.name: Missile Team
missile_team.job: An anti-armor team: they fire the heavy weapon from as far away as they can and stay out of reach.

guard_squad.name: Guard Squad
guard_squad.job: Armored soldiers who hold a place and duck when they're hit.

spotter_team.name: Spotter Team
spotter_team.job: Ambushers who hit hardest in the first round and stay hidden.

medic_team.name: Medic Team
medic_team.job: Steady soldiers who keep their heads down and keep firing (no book module heals; the medic part is flavour).

drop_squad.name: Drop Squad
drop_squad.job: Jump troops who fly when they move.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.job: One soldier on foot (a guard, a sentry, an officer).
